attributes.name: Charmed Red Dragon
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 5 and the Fire trait to any combat check. Then roll 1d12. On a 1, banish this card, and each character at your location is dealt 1d4 Fire damage.

If you fail the check to acquire this card, each character at your location is dealt 1d4 Fire damage.
